description: Whether a pair's AMM pool and its order book are apart after the AMM fee: per direction the gap, the executable size and the profit after transfer fees. When to use: To find whether a pair's AMM pool and its funded order book are apart after the AMM fee, in which direction, how much base the gap allows and the profit after transfer fees, optionally with the cycles of the USD registry stablecoins via XRP. Prefer another tool: To estimate the cost of a trade of a given size, CLOB against AMM (use `/v1/xrpl/slippage`), or to read the order book levels (use `/v1/xrpl/orderbook`) or an AMM pool (use `/v1/xrpl/amm/{a}/{b}`); the answer measures the ledger and is not an executable quote. Example: xrpl_metrics_arbitrage {"base":"XRP","quote":"524C555344000000000000000000000000000000.rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De"}

base.description: Base currency of the pair: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

include_triangles.description: The string "true" adds the cycles of the USD registry coins (RLUSD, USDC) via XRP; "false" or omitted leaves them out

quote.description: Quote currency of the pair, different from base: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

name: xrpl_metrics_arbitrage

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

amm_spot_price.description: Fee-free spot of the pair's pool, quote per base (quote reserve / base reserve), an input of both gaps; null without a usable pool (none, frozen or empty)

amm_to_clob.description: Buy base on the AMM pool and sell it into the order book's bids

best_bid.description: Price of the best funded bid, quote per base, an input of gap_bps; null when the bid side is empty

executable_base.description: Base quantity tradable before the pool's marginal price reaches the book level prices, in units of `base`; "0" when not open

gap_bps.description: Gap between the book's best price and the pool price after the AMM fee in basis points, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; positive means open; null when the direction cannot be evaluated

net_quote_profit.description: Quote profit of executable_base after the issuers' transfer fees and before the XRP transaction costs of the legs; "0" when not open; null when a transfer rate is unknown

status.description: open when gap_bps is positive; no_opportunity otherwise, or when the direction cannot be evaluated (no usable pool or the book side empty); a defined computation and not advice

base.description: Base asset queried, in the canonical form the route reads (echo)

base_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `base`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

clob_to_amm.description: Buy base from the order book's asks and sell it into the AMM pool

best_ask.description: Price of the best funded ask, quote per base, an input of gap_bps; null when the ask side is empty

executable_base.description: Base quantity tradable before the pool's marginal price reaches the book level prices, in units of `base`; "0" when not open

gap_bps.description: Gap between the book's best price and the pool price after the AMM fee in basis points, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; positive means open; null when the direction cannot be evaluated

net_quote_profit.description: Quote profit of executable_base after the issuers' transfer fees and before the XRP transaction costs of the legs; "0" when not open; null when a transfer rate is unknown

status.description: open when gap_bps is positive; no_opportunity otherwise, or when the direction cannot be evaluated (no usable pool or the book side empty); a defined computation and not advice

quote.description: Quote asset queried, in the canonical form the route reads (echo)

quote_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `quote`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

trading_fee_pct.description: Trading fee of the pair's pool in percent (TradingFee / 1000), an input of both gaps; null without a usable pool (none, frozen or empty)

triangles.description: Present only with include_triangles=true: the cycles of the USD registry coins (RLUSD, USDC) via XRP, both directions, from top of book

gap_bps.description: Product of the top-of-book leg rates after the taker transfer fees, as basis points above 1, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null when a leg's book side is empty or a transfer rate is unknown

legs.description: The three legs of the cycle, in cycle order; gap_bps is computed from their rates

input_asset.description: Asset the leg sells: XRP or CODE.issuer

input_asset_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `input_asset`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

output_asset.description: Asset the leg receives: XRP or CODE.issuer

output_asset_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `output_asset`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

price_after_fees.description: Fee-inclusive rate of the leg, output per input: the best bid of the book selling input_asset for output_asset, divided by the input asset issuer's transfer rate / 1e9 (1 for XRP); null when that book side is empty or the transfer rate is unknown

path.description: The cycle as symbols, from XRP back to XRP, for example ["XRP","RLUSD","USDC","XRP"]

top_size_xrp.description: XRP input that fills the smallest first bid level of the legs, each leg's level grossed up by its input asset's transfer rate and carried back to XRP through the preceding legs' rates; null when gap_bps is null
